name: Habit Assistant
description: Your personal habit companion with AI and team support.

ui.start_text:
👋 Welcome to Habit Assistant!

Build better habits, track your progress, and stay consistent with the help of AI.

🌱 Create and manage habits
🤖 Get help from AI
👥 Work with your team
📖 Learn how everything works

You can type your request or send a voice message.
ui.help_text:
📖 Habit Assistant Help

Habit Assistant is focused on habits, progress, AI guidance, and team collaboration.

🌱 Habits — create, edit, track, and review habits
🤖 AI Assistant — create habits from natural language or voice and ask questions about your habits
👥 Teams — collaborate with other people
🎙️ Voice — describe a habit naturally and let AI process it

This bot does not manage tasks.
ui.feature_intro: ✨ Everything you need to build and maintain better habits.
